compounddef.initializer: template<typename T> concept astrea::astro::detail::SymbolicConstant = (!std::is_const_v<T>) && (!std::is_reference_v<T>) && std::is_empty_v<T> && std::is_trivially_default_constructible_v<T> && std::is_trivially_copy_constructible_v<T> && std::is_trivially_move_constructible_v<T> && std::is_trivially_destructible_v<T>

briefdescription.para: A symbolic constant is a type that is empty, trivially constructible, trivially copyable, trivially moveable, and trivially destructible.
